messages.text: [mission] 4 walk-through opening(s) had a wall standing in them and were cut open: op-waiting-weststair (ground, wall:waiting y[-0.01,4.01]); op-rest-office (ground, wall:openoffice y[-0.01,4.11]); op-office-conf-door (ground, wall:openoffice y[-0.01,4.31]); op-archive-wstair (upper, wall:archive y[3.99,7.61]). Cause: buildWalls places an opening at `o.at - seg.a` but adds an axis-z wall rotated by PI/2, which reverses the along-wall axis, so the hole is punched at the mirror of the doorway and the doorway itself stays solid. Fix in src/map/build.js: use `x: seg.axis === 'z' ? seg.b - o.at : o.at - seg.a` where localOps is built.
